panels.gesture: Impatient dismissive speech, half-lidded eyes and a compressed brow; one hand sweeping sideways in a short brush-off, palm outward and fingers relaxed, other hand low. A clear dismissive wave, not a stop sign.

Upper lip slightly lifted under the moustache, nostrils subtly flared, narrowed sideways gaze; head tilted away and one wrist loosely turned down at the lower chest. Disdain conveyed through posture, no drawn breath marks.
Dry conspiratorial side glance and small crooked malicious smile; one cupped hand near the side of his mouth without hiding his face, opposite arm tucked near his ribs, only a slight lean.

Sardonic mocking smile with one arched brow; both hands form a small outward display at chest height, palms facing outward obliquely, as if mimicking another man's pompous manners. No actual bird or other person.
Disapproving eyes and pinched mouth, brow deeply creased; one forefinger taps into the opposite open palm to enumerate a breach of etiquette. Hands fully readable with correct fingers.
Stubborn closed mouth and firm narrowed eyes, chin drawn back; one hand grips the opposite forearm low across the torso, shoulders set, refusing to be persuaded without an aggressive combat posture.
A tiny smug corner smile, gaze angled down at the listener; one index finger gently lifted horizontally as if correcting one detail, other hand gathering a small fold of his own robe near the waist.

Fleeting awkwardness in the eyes, brows lifted at the center; a loose fist brought just below the mouth for a quiet throat-clear, opposite hand smoothing his robe at the lower chest. He covers a small social blunder and tries to recover dignity.

Impatient resigned half-grimace and slightly raised brow; one hand extended low and loosely outward, palm up, the other resting at his hip. A small dismissive shoulder lift, not a broad surprised shrug.
